tie_reference: TIE (2026). Biology for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 2. Dar es Salaam: TIE.
source_note: Verified Biology Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). Term I lessons 1-13 cover animal nutrition and digestion, transport in organisms (plants, mammalian heart/blood/circulation), and gas exchange. Term II lessons 14-24 cover breathing mechanics, respiratory disorders, coordination, excretion and homeostasis, reproduction and growth, and practical biological techniques. Lesson plan weeks for mid-term assessments/breaks and revision/exam weeks carry no teaching content and are intentionally omitted. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.
